fields.title: TrustRadius record
fields.description: Every record carries _input, _source, _scrapedAt and recordType. recordType is REVIEW (one review), PRODUCT_DETAILS (a full product profile), PRODUCT (one row of a category's ranked list), ALTERNATIVE (a competitor or alternative of a product), COMPARISON (a head-to-head page), CATEGORY (a node of the category tree) or ERROR. Upstream objects are passed through close to verbatim, so fields beyond those listed can appear.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The product, category or comparison you passed in that produced this record.

_source.title: Source
_source.description: tr-rsc-reviews | tr-rsc-reviews+legacy-detail | tr-rsc-product | tr-rsc-category | tr-legacy-competitors | tr-rsc-compare | tr-rsc-categories | none (errors).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: REVIEW | PRODUCT_DETAILS | PRODUCT | ALTERNATIVE | COMPARISON | CATEGORY | ERROR.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on ERROR records: not_found | blocked | unexpected_shape | invalid_input | exception.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description: A non-fatal gap, e.g. a review whose detail page could not be read.

productSlug.title: Product slug
productSlug.description: REVIEW: the product the review belongs to.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Review slug on REVIEW, product slug on PRODUCT / PRODUCT_DETAILS / ALTERNATIVE, category slug on CATEGORY.

rating.title: Rating (0-10)
rating.description: REVIEW: the reviewer's likelihood-to-recommend score; PRODUCT_DETAILS: the aggregate rating object.

source.title: Review sourcing
source.description: trusted / incentive / source as TrustRadius labels it (e.g. incentivized via RaaS).

reviewer.title: Reviewer
reviewer.description: Role, department, company size, industry, experience. Name, company, photo and LinkedIn only when the reviewer made them public.

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: Every question/answer block shown on the review list.

details.title: Full questionnaire
details.description: Only with 'Include the full review questionnaire': feature ratings by name, usability, ROI, alternatives evaluated, other software used, reviewer country and roles.

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: PRODUCT: position in the category's default ranking.

trScore.title: trScore
trScore.description: TrustRadius's weighted score used for ranking.

product.title: Product (raw)
product.description: PRODUCT: the full product object as the category page ships it.

pricingPage.title: Pricing page
pricingPage.description: PRODUCT_DETAILS with 'Include the pricing page': reviewer price quotes, support, deployment, priced alternatives.

industryInstallShare.title: Install base by industry
industryInstallShare.description: HG Insights installation counts by NAICS industry.

forProduct.title: Alternative of
forProduct.description: ALTERNATIVE: the product whose alternatives these are.

lists.title: Lists and positions
lists.description: ALTERNATIVE: which lists the product appears in (competitors, alternatives_all / _small / _medium / _large) and at which position.

products.title: Compared products
products.description: COMPARISON: rating, buy-again/value insights and pricing editions per product.

featureGroups.title: Feature comparison
featureGroups.description: COMPARISON: per-feature scores and winner per product.
